candidates: config/initializers/i18n.rb:17 - The fallback chain depends on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the translate cache key doesn't include it.. The fallback chain now changes at runtime with `SiteSetting.default_locale`. `translate` caches results under `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{backend.object_id}"`, so a result that came from the fallback is cached for the user's locale. After an admin changes the default locale, users whose locale lacks a key keep getting the cached text from the old default locale until the LRU entry is evicted or the process restarts. Fix: add the default locale (or the whole fallback chain) to the cache key, or clear the cache when `default_locale` changes.

lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:62 - Fallback locales are only loaded in the controller, so translations outside a request don't fall back.. `translate` still lazy-loads only `config.locale`. The fallback locales (site default and `:en`) get loaded only by `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` in `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Code that sets `I18n.locale` and translates outside a controller request (Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks) can run in a process where those locales were never loaded. For a key missing in the user's locale, `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` then finds nothing in the unloaded fallback locales and returns "translation missing" instead of the English text. Fix: load the fallback chain in `translate` itself, for example by calling `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` (or `ensure_loaded!` for each locale in `I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]`) instead of loading only `config.locale`.
